niphal.sense_hint: simple (this root has no attested qal; niphal serves as its basic/citation stem)

notes: True homograph of the existing H5401 (נָשַׁק, "kiss") -- same bare consonants נשק once the sin/shin dot (a diacritic, not a separate letter) is stripped, genuinely unrelated meanings -- added as נשק¹ (lower Strong's number) per the ascending-Strong's-number superscript convention; H5401 is retroactively renamed נשק² in this same batch.
Gloss overlap (stem-level, not a search-index collision): "catch fire" matches the existing לקח (H3947) hitpael stem_gloss, whose own root-level gloss is "take" -- no alias needed.
